gate_criteria.description: Background work is driven by durable jobs and outbox events with bounded retries and DLQ; no duplicate emails, grants, season resets or dropped tasks
verified_points: Durable job and outbox primitives in packages/services/jobs.js (createJobService) supporting typed/versioned envelopes, transactional producer enqueues, claim/lease metadata with monotonic fence tokens, stale worker rejection, exponential backoff, dead-letter state (state='failed'), and operator retry tools.

Email outbox, notifications, cleanup and privacy/deletion workflows extracted into apps/worker and packages/services/worker-workflows.js. Preserves HKDF AES-256-GCM encryption format, proves zero OTP/secret leaks into logs, proves jobs survive Core restarts, and verifies privacy cancellation and retention purge.

Provider notification and store finalization workflows extracted into packages/services/provider-workflows.js with migration 0043 providing primary key on monetization.store_finalize. Proves ingest deduplication, finalization strictly after durable receipt grant, duplicate/retried callbacks never remint, refund revocations, and crash recovery.

Season, leaderboard, and maintenance scheduling extracted into packages/services/maintenance-scheduler.js using stable UTC period identities (snapshot:<day>, weekly:<week>:<today>) and Core-owned operator commands. Proves two concurrent workers produce exactly one business effect, verifies downtime catch-up across multiple days and closed weeks, and enforces zero fabricated rewards.

Legacy duplicate schedulers removed from Game Core and documented in docs/v5/WORKER-HEALTH.md. Proven that only one business effect occurs even when old/new-compatible processes overlap during a deploy across mail, store finalization, daily snapshots, and weekly payouts.
